Persisted boolean/nonfinite/malformed stop-loss/entry/target prices could be actionable or silently disable protection; an in-flight operator stop-level change could leave a stale watcher snapshot able to submit a SELL. Filter malformed persisted prices and revalidate active record after broker inquiry; preserve raw records. Revalidation reduces but cannot eliminate the race without broker-side idempotent reconciliation.

Legacy stop-loss entries without updated_at could be removed by watcher after an in-flight zero-holdings check even if a concurrent BUY had re-registered a new protection. Added expected_record CAS and two watcher race regressions, plus malformed-record fail-closed removal.
Legacy stop-loss record could be modified in-flight without changing stop_loss or absent updated_at; stale snapshot passed pre-submit check. Now compare full tracked record; regression added.

Generic broker success=False without authoritative KIS rejection proof was classified failed and could be automatically replayed. Fail closed to unknown; verified business rejection still retryable. Six CI regressions discovered and corrected same run; latest CI successful.

New lowercase and uppercase US stop-loss registrations previously produced two active durable records and disabled watcher protection for the symbol. Canonicalize new writes, refuse overwrite of unresolved legacy case variants/quarantine.

Configured stop-loss ledger filename ending .tmp collides with fixed temp sibling, allowing in-place truncate and crash corruption; unique same-directory temporary file with fsync and os.replace plus failure regression.

After normalizing new US stop-loss writes to uppercase, lowercase get/remove calls would otherwise miss the canonical record. Added exact-key-first, canonical fallback lookup preserving legacy raw keys.
ExecutionLedger.finalize unconditionally rewrote an already protected executed/unknown status as failed/rejected/deferred; claim() would then allow duplicate submission.
